items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Russell Smith? [INTERVIEWEE] No. A short, fat one. He was with Fletcher, he was with Chick, he was with Russell's band

ctx.x: No. A short, fat one. He was with Fletcher, he was with Chick, he was with Russell's band -- he was with the band playing "Old Man River."
